answer: Attestations can be graph-blind: each epoch an issuer blind-signs one fresh pseudonym per identity, and the registry keeps a narrow ledge of signatures; it verifies attestations but never learns which aliases belong together. No thread ties an identity across epochs or links two endorsers in one ring, since pseudonyms are unlinkable and single-use. A praise circle cannot find its partners, so coordinated upvoting dissolves into noise. A farmer reconstructing puppet aliases must break blind-signature unforgeability, jade-hard, while an honest agent signs once per epoch.
